title: Enormous Elderberry's cards Embiggen for no extra mana
notes: Meditative+ #23 Enormous Elderberry adds its cards with no Embiggen premium (noEmbiggenPremium, R4350000): their Embiggened version costs their normal price, read live under every modifier, and under Mountaintop Garden so does the dearer choice; the card text says so. R1181003's (0) is superseded and the v0.6.8d script kept for replays (R767000). Ruling R4350000. The plays are the cards classify finds playing differently through it: the Fruit pools that reach the Elderberry (C+ #68, S #141, S+ #5) and cards in the games an Elderberry play changes (S #51, #52, #82, #83, #140).

player.title: Enormous Elderberry's cards Embiggen for no extra mana
